title: Multilingual Argument Mining: Datasets and Analysis
reasoning: The paper creates and uses datasets for argument mining that are based on controversial topics, many of which are explicitly related to morals, ethics, and religion. For example, topics used for evaluation include 'We should prohibit school prayer', 'We should adopt libertarianism', 'We should ban missionary work', and 'We should adopt atheism'. The work benchmarks a model's ability to classify argument stance and quality on these ethically and religiously charged subjects.
